summary: This document describes the CourseDetail class and its various methods and properties used for manipulating course details within the HSPnet system.
purpose: To manage course details including adding, updating, copying, and deleting entries in the HSPnet system.

workflows.name: Managing Course Details
steps: Add course detail using Add method
Update course detail using Update method
Delete course detail using Delete method
Copy course detail using Copy method
Retrieve course detail by CourseID with GetByCourseID method
Retrieve course detail by ID with GetByID method

business_rules: Ensure Response is not blank before proceeding with operations
Use DescriptionAlt for formatted descriptions if UseAltLanguageFields is true
calculations: Determine the numbering character and indent level based on NumberingCode
system_behavior: Uses stored SQL procedures like CourseDetailsAdd, CourseDetailsUpdate, CourseDetailsDelete, CourseDetailsCopy
